title: Cruise control on a hill

mapping.source: slow for a while, keep adding

breaks_down: A car controls speed while the drone controls height, which adds one more step between push and result. That extra step is why the drone bounces and the P-only car does not, so the car has no bounce for D to fix: D belongs to the drone. A human driver also sees the hill coming and presses early; a basic PID only reacts to the gap it already has.
